articles.titleCn: 在使用大型语言模型进行民意调查之前：一个审慎的诊断框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能否像人类一样通过新信息进行推理，还是仅仅检索缓存的观点？这对于硅基采样至关重要，其中大型语言模型角色在规模上模拟公众舆论。当前的评估仅测试角色是否持有正确的观点——一个静态快照。但舆论研究越来越依赖于动态保真度：角色是否像人类在审议过程中那样根据新论点更新信念。目前没有现有的基准测试这一点。我们引入了审议投票诊断框架，该框架比较人类和大型语言模型在经历相同信息干预后的信念变化。基于审议投票，它揭示了静态评估无法发现的缺陷：能够生成看似合理的党派观点的模型仍然可能错误地表现这些观点如何变化。将框架应用于使用“一室美国”（526个角色，72个问题）数据的五个前沿模型，我们发现每个模型都失败了，并且每个模型的失败方式都不同。GPT-5.1表现出逆转：在平衡信息后，其角色对对立党的敌意增加，而人类则减少。这种逆转具有选择性（针对群体外问题占80%，针对政策问题占26%），并且在党派身份上是对称的。Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Llama 3.3 70B表现出过度放大，正确地变化但幅度是人类5-7倍。DeepSeek V3表现出僵化，变化接近于零。有针对性的消融实验表明，政策内容触发了这些失败，并且它们具有身份特异性：GPT-5.1在群体外问题上逆转，但在群体内问题上过度放大；Gemini则相反。我们将这种特征称为自我自恋：角色对模型内部对角色的刻板印象的服从，而不是根据提供的信息进行推理。我们的框架提供了一个具体协议：在信任大型语言模型角色模仿更新信念之前，先运行审议诊断。

articles.title: CiteGuard-RAG: A Validation-Centered AI System for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve access to complex information; however, retrieving evidence alone does not ensure that answers are grounded, citation-valid, or appropriately refused. This paper introduces CiteGuard-RAG, a validation-centered AI system for evidence-grounded question answering. The system integrates hybrid semantic-lexical retrieval, citation-constrained generation, sentence-level grounding validation, and single-pass regeneration. Validation is used at runtime to determine whether a candidate answer should be accepted, refused, or regenerated before final delivery. CiteGuard-RAG is evaluated on 400 questions across a controlled housing-law dataset, PrivacyQA, and CUAD. In the controlled evaluation, it achieves 99.1% retrieval accuracy, 98.3% grounded-answer accuracy, and 98.3% citation validity, with no validation-detected hallucinations. Ablation results show that grounded-answer accuracy drops sharply when validation is removed, even when retrieval accuracy remains unchanged. External evaluation shows that while citation validity remains strong, evidence utilization, span alignment, and refusal calibration become harder under domain shift. These findings indicate that trustworthy RAG systems require explicit validation between retrieval and final answer delivery. CiteGuard-RAG provides a practical architecture for linking retrieval, generation, citation checking, abstention, and regeneration in high-stakes information access.
articles.comment: Submitted to Engineering Reports. 22 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables
articles.titleCn: CiteGuard-RAG：一个以验证为中心的证据支持型问答AI系统
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）能够提升对复杂信息的获取能力；然而，仅检索证据并不能确保答案具有事实依据、引用有效或适当拒绝。本文介绍了CiteGuard-RAG，这是一个以验证为中心的证据性问答AI系统。该系统集成了混合语义-词汇检索、引用约束生成、句子级事实依据验证和单次再生。验证在运行时用于确定候选答案应在最终交付前被接受、拒绝或再生。CiteGuard-RAG在受控住房法数据集PrivacyQA和CUAD上的400个问题中进行了评估。在受控评估中，它达到了99.1%的检索准确率、98.3%的事实依据答案准确率和98.3%的引用有效性，且未发现验证检测到的幻觉。消融实验表明，当移除验证时，即使检索准确率保持不变，事实依据答案准确率也会急剧下降。外部评估显示，虽然引用有效性仍然很强，但在领域迁移下，证据利用、跨度对齐和拒绝校准变得更加困难。这些结果表明，可信的RAG系统需要在检索和最终答案交付之间进行明确的验证。CiteGuard-RAG提供了一个实用的架构，用于在高风险信息获取中将检索、生成、引用检查、拒绝和再生联系起来。

articles.title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
articles.abstract: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneous data sources nor adapts to different agent behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents. EvoOntology encapsulates the ontology as an MCP server comprising a schema layer, a content layer, and a tool layer, enabling agents to actively query and interact with the ontology at runtime. To this end, we introduce a builder agent for autonomous ontology construction and a self-evolution loop that continuously refines the ontology through attribution-guided typed edits that are accepted only after a backbone-conditional paired evaluation. Experiments on three well-adopted data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones demonstrate that EvoOntology consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing semantic-layer approaches, effectively bridging the agent-data gap and enabling more effective interaction with heterogeneous data. Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology
articles.titleCn: EvoOntology：数据代理的自进化本体层
articles.abstractCn: 数据代理旨在处理异构数据（包括表格、文件和数据库）的自然语言指令。然而，数据代理面临一个具有挑战性的代理-数据差距：异构数据存储在代理外部，而代理只能通过通用工具访问这些数据（例如列名和文件路径）。现有方法要么让代理直接探索原始数据源，要么将手动构建的语义层注入提示中。然而，这两种方法都难以扩展到大型异构数据源，也无法适应不同的代理行为。在本文中，我们介绍了EvoOntology，一种用于数据代理的自进化本体层。EvoOntology将本体封装为一个MCP服务器，该服务器包含模式层、内容层和工具层，使代理能够在运行时主动查询和交互本体。为此，我们引入了一个用于自主本体构建的构建代理，以及一个自我进化循环，该循环通过归因引导的类型编辑不断改进本体，并且只有经过骨干条件配对评估后才接受这些编辑。在三个广泛采用的数据代理基准测试上，使用四个LLM骨干网络进行的实验表明，EvoOntology始终优于强大的基线方法和现有的语义层方法，有效地弥合了代理-数据差距，并实现了与异构数据更有效的交互。代码：https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology

articles.title: Enabling Streaming User Transcription in Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Models
articles.abstract: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models enable natural conversational AI by allowing simultaneous listening and speaking. However, these models typically lack inherent user speech transcription, which is essential for applications such as conversation logging, accessibility features, and quality monitoring. In this work, we propose an efficient method to add streaming ASR capabilities to an existing duplex S2S model by introducing a lightweight ASR head in parallel to the agent text head. Our approach requires minimal additional parameters and no significant architectural changes to the base S2S model, enabling real-time user transcription while preserving full-duplex conversational capabilities including turn-taking and barge-in handling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves streaming average WER of 10.21% on the HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard within the duplex S2S framework. Additionally, we show that the same architecture trained as a standalone streaming ASR model achieves competitive results (7.73% WER) compared to current SOTA models. We will open-source our training and inference code to facilitate further research in joint streaming ASR and S2S modeling.
articles.titleCn: 在全双工语音转语音模型中启用流式用户转录
articles.abstractCn: 全双工语音转语音（S2S）模型通过允许同时收听和说话，实现了自然对话式人工智能。然而，这些模型通常缺乏内在的用户语音转写功能，这对于对话记录、无障碍功能和质量监控等应用至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种高效的方法，通过在代理文本头并行引入一个轻量级的语音识别（ASR）头，为现有的全双工S2S模型添加流式ASR功能。我们的方法只需要最少的额外参数，并且不需要对基础S2S模型进行重大架构变更，能够在保留全双工对话能力（包括轮流发言和打断处理）的同时实现实时用户转写。实验结果表明，我们的方法在全双工S2S框架内实现了10.21%的流式平均词错误率（WER）的HuggingFace Open ASR排行榜成绩。此外，我们还展示了相同架构作为独立流式ASR模型训练时，与当前SOTA模型相比取得了具有竞争力的结果（7.73% WER）。我们将开源我们的训练和推理代码，以促进联合流式ASR和S2S建模的进一步研究。

articles.title: Sequential Adapter Stacking for Cross-Lingual Low-Resource ASR
articles.abstract: Extending large-scale multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to low-resource languages remains challenging. Model performance is skewed toward high-resource languages and degrades sharply for languages with limited labeled data and pre-training exposure. To address this, we investigate parameter-efficient approaches for transferring knowledge from resource-rich source languages to low-resource target languages on Whisper. Alongside warm initialization and attention-based fusion, we propose Sequential Adapter Stacking, which places a trainable target-language adapter on top of a frozen source-language adapter. Under controlled experiments, these approaches are evaluated on three target languages unsupported by Whisper -- Asturian, Assamese, and Xhosa -- using source languages with varying degrees of relatedness. Sequential Adapter Stacking with the closest related source consistently and significantly outperforms full fine-tuning across the three targets, with 5--8\% relative WER reductions. These gains largely persist with only one hour of target training data.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言低资源语音识别的顺序适配器堆叠
articles.abstractCn: 将大规模多语言自动语音识别（ASR）模型扩展到低资源语言仍然具有挑战性。模型性能偏向于高资源语言，而对于标签数据有限且预训练接触较少的语言，性能会急剧下降。为解决这一问题，我们研究了在Whisper上从资源丰富的源语言向低资源目标语言迁移知识的参数高效方法。除了热初始化和基于注意力的融合之外，我们提出了顺序适配器堆叠方法，该方法在冻结的源语言适配器之上放置一个可训练的目标语言适配器。在受控实验中，这些方法在Whisper不支持的三个目标语言——阿斯图里亚斯语、阿萨姆语和科萨语上进行了评估，使用具有不同程度相关性的源语言。顺序适配器堆叠方法与最相关的源语言始终且显著地优于在三个目标语言上的全量微调，相对WER降低了5--8%。这些收益在仅使用一小时目标训练数据的情况下仍然很大程度上得以保持。

articles.title: Look Before You Leap: Factual Decoding with Internal Attribution Signals
articles.abstract: Hallucination remains a critical challenge in large language models (LLMs), where early factual errors compound through autoregressive generation in a snowballing effect that neither post-hoc correction nor weight-level intervention can effectively preempt. We propose DescaPE (DEcoding Signal Control Against Path Error-snowballing), a decoding framework that leverages internal model signals to suppress hallucination-prone trajectories at inference time. Through sliding-window MLP ablation, we identify a factual-salient layer span within LLMs whose derived signal is selectively elevated for factual tokens and exhibits anomalous spikes at hallucination-prone steps. We train a lightweight probe to approximate this signal from a single forward pass and integrate it into candidate scoring to penalize high-risk continuations while rewarding factually grounded ones. Experiments across five factuality benchmarks on three LLMs demonstrate that DescaPE achieves factuality improvements over decoding-time baselines in multiple settings, while incurring only 1.10x latency overhead in our efficiency evaluation. Our code is available at https://github.com/hayeonggg/DESCAPE.
articles.titleCn: 三思而后行：基于内部归因信号的事实解码
articles.abstractCn: 幻觉仍然是大型语言模型（LLMs）中的一个关键挑战，其中早期的事实性错误通过自回归生成在雪崩效应中不断累积，而事后的校正或权重级别的干预都无法有效预防。我们提出了DescaPE（DEcoding Signal Control Against Path Error-snowballing，解码信号控制对抗路径错误雪崩），这是一种解码框架，它利用内部模型信号在推理时抑制易产生幻觉的轨迹。通过滑动窗口MLP消融实验，我们识别出LLMs中一个事实性突出的层跨度，其产生的信号在推理时被选择性地提升用于事实性标记，并在易产生幻觉的步骤中表现出异常峰值。我们训练了一个轻量级的探针来从单次前向传递中近似这个信号，并将其集成到候选评分中，以惩罚高风险的延续部分，同时奖励基于事实的延续部分。在三个LLMs上进行的五个事实性基准测试实验表明，DescaPE在多种设置下实现了相对于解码时基线的事实性改进，同时在我们的效率评估中仅增加了1.10倍的延迟开销。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hayeonggg/DESCAPE获取。

articles.title: Merging the Knowledge of LLMs for Automatic Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, trained on paired speech-text data, have been improved by leveraging language models (LMs) trained on text-only data. LM fusion methods such as shallow fusion and density ratio are well-established methods that incorporate external LMs during ASR decoding. However, they incur additional computational costs due to LM inference, which is particularly problematic for recent larger LMs. In this study, we propose incorporating external LMs via model merging. This method integrates the LMs directly into the parameters of an LLM-based ASR model, requiring no additional computational cost at inference. We formulate domain extension and transfer via arithmetic operations on LoRA parameters. Experimental evaluations were conducted for the domain adaptation of LLM-based ASR trained on CSJ and LibriSpeech. We show that our LM merging consistently improved the ASR performance in the target domains, without degrading inference speed or memory footprint.
articles.titleCn: 融合大型语言模型的知识的自动语音识别
articles.abstractCn: 基于配对语音-文本数据训练的自动语音识别（ASR）系统，通过利用仅基于文本训练的语言模型（LM）得到了改进。浅层融合和密度比等LM融合方法是将外部LM在ASR解码过程中整合的成熟方法。然而，由于LM推理会带来额外的计算成本，这对近年来更大规模的LM尤其成问题。在本研究中，我们提出通过模型融合来整合外部LM。该方法将LM直接集成到基于大型语言模型（LLM）的ASR模型的参数中，推理时无需额外计算成本。我们通过在LoRA参数上执行算术运算来构建领域扩展和迁移。针对在CSJ和LibriSpeech上训练的基于LLM的ASR的领域自适应，我们进行了实验评估。结果表明，我们的LM融合方法在目标领域始终提升了ASR性能，且未降低推理速度或内存占用。

articles.title: Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details
articles.abstract: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. An empirical evaluation shows that 76.4% and 74.3% of respondents rated the "What-if" and "Why-not" data stories as more comprehensible, with significantly higher accessibility scores than traditional SHAP visualizations. The paper concludes with the presentation of a narrative interpretation framework that integrates IML and data storytelling, thereby expanding the research scope as well as the practical applicability of AI decision-making.
articles.titleCn: 数据故事讲述与可解释机器学习相遇：为非专业人士解码AI决策，同时不泄露敏感数据与模型细节
articles.abstractCn: AI驱动的自动化决策需要兼顾预测性能和可解释性。近年来，可解释机器学习（IML）的发展为解释模型预测提供了工具，但这些解释的技术复杂性可能阻碍非专业人士的获取。为应对这一挑战，本研究将数据叙事与IML相结合，以提升AI生成决策的可解释性，使其面向更广泛的受众。本研究遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，提出了IML中数据叙事的正式定义，引入DIST金字塔框架以协调数据叙事与IML的关联，并提出了I-P-O模型来描述它们之间的交互。进一步地，本研究开发了一种架构，通过独特的"假设情景"和"为何不"事件生成过程来解释AI决策，并采用数据脱敏技术保护敏感输入数据。为验证该方法，本研究以波士顿房价数据集为例，利用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）值和大型语言模型（LLMs）生成具有And-But-Therefore（ABT）结构的叙事化数据故事。实证评估显示，76.4%和74.3%的受访者认为"假设情景"和"为何不"的数据叙事比传统SHAP可视化更易理解，其可访问性评分显著更高。本文最后提出了一个整合IML与数据叙事的叙事化解释框架，从而扩展了AI决策研究范围及其实际应用价值。

articles.title: Universal Defenses for Tool-Integrated LLM Agents Against Adversarial Attacks
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a variety of domains, particularly when integrated with external tools for multi-step task completion. However, they are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and backdoor attacks, which exploit the model's openness to prompt injection and tool manipulation. In this work, we explore practical and generalizable defense strategies within a unified framework across these four attack types. We introduce two universal tool-based defenses: Attacker Tool Filtering, which uses anomaly detection (e.g., Isolation Forest) to identify and remove suspicious tools, and Normal Tool Recalling, a white-box method that restores the agent's original toolset prior to planning. Additionally, we incorporate prompt-based defenses: Chain-of-Thought prompting and self-reflection techniques to enhance reasoning and task paraphrasing to mitigate attacks. Experimental results across both four open-source LLMs (Gemma2-9B, Qwen2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and LLaMA3.1-8B) and three proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-5) show that our methods significantly reduce the Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving 0% ASR in many settings, while preserving or even improving the original task success rate. These findings highlight the promise of simple, modular, multi-layered defenses for strengthening the security and robustness of tool-integrated LLM agents. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyan-Lisa/Defenses-for-Tool-Integrated-LLM-Agents-Against-Adversarial-Attacks.
articles.titleCn: 针对对抗性攻击的工具集成大型语言模型代理的通用防御
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在多个领域展现出令人印象深刻的性能，尤其是在与外部工具集成以完成多步任务时。然而，它们正日益容易受到对抗性攻击，包括直接提示注入、间接提示注入、内存中毒和后门攻击，这些攻击利用了模型对提示注入和工具操作的开放性。在这项工作中，我们在这四种攻击类型中探索了实用且可推广的防御策略，在一个统一的框架内进行。我们引入了两种基于工具的通用防御策略：攻击者工具过滤，它使用异常检测（例如隔离森林）来识别和移除可疑工具，以及正常工具召回，这是一种白盒方法，在规划之前恢复代理的原始工具集。此外，我们还结合了基于提示的防御策略：思维链提示和自我反思技术，以增强推理和任务释义，从而减轻攻击。在四个开源LLM（Gemma2-9B、Qwen2-7B、LLaMA3-8B和LLaMA3.1-8B）和三个专有LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4和GPT-5）上的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著降低了攻击成功率（ASR），在许多情况下实现了0%的ASR，同时保持了甚至提高了原始任务的成功率。这些发现突出了简单、模块化、多层防御策略在加强集成工具的LLM代理的安全性和鲁棒性方面的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/Xiaoyan-Lisa/Defenses-for-Tool-Integrated-LLM-Agents-Against-Adversarial-Attacks获取。

articles.title: RESKILL: Explicit Failure Attribution and Structured Repair for Interactive Language Agents
articles.abstract: Language agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, but post-failure repair is often handled by opaque one-shot reflection: a model generates a skill patch without explicitly maintaining how failure explanations relate to candidate repairs or how unsuccessful retests should influence later edits. We introduce RESKILL, a structured repair framework that maintains an explicit repair state across repair rounds. Given a failed rollout, the framework links failure hypotheses to candidate skill patches, selects local repairs through coverage-based attribution, retests the edited skill set in the environment, and uses retest outcomes to guide subsequent repair updates. The language model supplies structured repair factors, while the repair procedure records them, compares local skill patches by how well they address active failure explanations, and carries unsuccessful retest outcomes into later repair rounds. We evaluate RESKILL on ALFWorld and TextCraft across three model sizes under fixed repair budgets. RESKILL obtains the strongest final success in all six benchmark-model settings, improving average final success by 3.7 percentage points over direct repair and 3.3 points over hypothesis-conditioned repair. These results suggest that explicit attribution alone is insufficient; durable improvement emerges when attribution is integrated with repair selection and persistent retest-conditioned update.
articles.titleCn: 技能重塑：交互式语言代理的明确失败归因与结构化修复
articles.abstractCn: 语言代理越来越依赖可重用的技能，但失败后的修复通常通过不透明的单次反思处理：模型生成技能补丁，但并未明确维护失败解释与候选修复的关系，也未明确维护未成功的重测如何影响后续编辑。我们引入了RESKILL，一个结构化的修复框架，该框架在修复轮次间维护明确的修复状态。给定一次失败的部署，该框架将失败假设链接到候选技能补丁，通过基于覆盖的归因选择局部修复，在环境中重测编辑后的技能集，并利用重测结果指导后续的修复更新。语言模型提供结构化的修复因素，而修复过程记录这些因素，通过评估局部技能补丁如何有效解决活跃的失败解释来比较它们，并将未成功的重测结果带入后续的修复轮次。我们在ALFWorld和TextCraft上，针对三种模型大小，在固定的修复预算下评估了RESKILL。RESKILL在所有六个基准模型设置中获得了最终的最高成功率，相较于直接修复平均提高了3.7个百分点，相较于假设条件修复平均提高了3.3个百分点。这些结果表明，仅靠明确的归因是不够的；当归因与修复选择和持续的重测条件更新相结合时，才能实现持久性的改进。

articles.title: RAG-CT: Mitigating Privacy Risks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems via Scanning Prompt Distribution
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the quality of generated contents of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding responses in external knowledge, thus reducing hallucinations and factual errors. However, recent studies have highlighted a critical vulnerability: adversaries can exploit the retrieval process to extract personally identifiable information (PII) from the underlying corpus. To mitigate this risk, we propose a novel defense, RAG-CT, that identifies malicious queries by analyzing their entropy and margin distributions and using a score-based detection method. Extensive experiments with four state-of-the-art attack strategies and four defense baselines on two datasets show that our approach significantly reduces PII leakage while outperforming existing defenses. This work provides a lightweight yet effective mechanism to protect RAG systems against PII leakage without requiring modifications to the underlying LLM or retriever.
articles.titleCn: RAG-CT：通过扫描提示分布减轻检索增强生成系统中的隐私风险
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种强大的范式，通过将外部知识融入响应来提升大型语言模型（LLM）生成内容的质量，从而减少幻觉和事实性错误。然而，近期研究表明存在一个关键漏洞：攻击者可以利用检索过程从底层语料库中提取个人身份信息（PII）。为缓解这一风险，我们提出了一种新型防御机制RAG-CT，通过分析恶意查询的熵和边缘分布，并采用基于分数的检测方法来识别恶意查询。在两个数据集上针对四种最先进的攻击策略和四种防御基线的实验表明，我们的方法显著减少了PII泄露，同时优于现有防御措施。这项工作提供了一种轻量级且有效的机制，可在无需修改底层LLM或检索器的情况下，保护RAG系统免受PII泄露的威胁。

articles.title: CiteShade: Citation Laundering in Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Its Counterfactual Defense
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's answers on retrieved external knowledge and returns each answer with citations that identify its sources. Those citations are the user's audit trail: they let a reader verify a claim without trusting the model. Prior security work on RAG asks whether an attacker can corrupt the answer, leaving the citation channel unexplored. We show that this channel is a new and practical attack surface. We propose CiteShade, the first citation laundering attack to RAG, in which an attacker controlling a single source induces a model to produce an attacker-chosen wrong answer and to attribute it to a trusted source that does not support it, while the evidence for the correct answer remains in context. We formulate the attack as an optimization problem, derive three necessary conditions (retrieval, generation, and citation) and construct sources satisfying them without any instruction. On multi-source multi-hop question answering the attack raises the wrong-answer rate from 0.01 to 0.68, and source deletion confirms the malicious source is the causal driver in every measured case. Vulnerability tracks a model's propensity to cite rather than its scale, reaching CLR 0.84 under explicit instruction and 0.64 with no instruction at all on the most citation-prone model tested. We then show that perplexity filtering and citation-support checking are each insufficient, and propose a counterfactual defense that verifies which source actually drove the answer.
articles.titleCn: CiteShade：多源检索增强生成中的引用清洗及其反事实防御
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）将语言模型的答案基于检索到的外部知识，并为每个答案附上引用，以标识其来源。这些引用是用户的审计追踪：它们让读者能够验证某个声明，而无需信任模型。以往关于RAG的安全研究主要探讨攻击者是否能够篡改答案，而忽略了引用渠道。我们证明这一渠道是一个新的、实际的攻击面。我们提出了CiteShade，这是首个针对RAG的引用清洗攻击，攻击者控制单一来源，诱使模型生成攻击者选择的错误答案，并将其归因于一个不支持该答案的可信来源，而正确答案的证据仍然保留在上下文中。我们将攻击形式化为一个优化问题，推导出三个必要条件（检索、生成和引用），并构建满足这些条件的来源，无需任何指令。在多源多跳问答中，攻击将错误答案率从0.01提高到0.68，而来源删除证实恶意来源在所有测量案例中都是因果驱动因素。漏洞追踪的是模型的引用倾向而非其规模，在明确指令下达到CLR 0.84，在完全不指令的情况下，在测试中最易引用的模型中达到0.64。然后我们证明困惑度过滤和引用支持检查均不足够，并提出一种反事实防御措施，验证实际驱动答案的来源。

articles.title: Empathy Is Steerable but Multi-Axial: Mechanism Geometry and Persona Effects in LLMs
articles.abstract: Activation steering has been used to control traits such as honesty, refusal, and sycophancy, yet supportive empathy is evaluated along multiple dimensions that need not correspond to independently controllable activation directions. Using the EPITOME framework, which decomposes supportive empathy into Emotional Reactions, Interpretations, and Explorations, we study three instruction-tuned LLMs and ask whether candidate directions derived from these labels produce distinguishable intervention effects or instead share structure, and how persona prompts interact with those directions. We find that contrastive activation addition yields a stable middle-layer intervention that consistently shifts the EPITOME proxy scores across models, moving empathy analysis beyond response-level scoring. However, the recovered directions are only partially separable: steering one direction induces off-target shifts, and hand-crafted prompting shifts the empathy profile rather than isolating a single dimension. Persona prompts substantially change EPITOME scores, but a paired activation-shift decomposition shows that the recovered subspace captures only approximately 3 percent of persona-induced squared activation-shift magnitude at layer 15. Under this EPITOME-based definition, expressed empathy is steerable but multi-axial, and controlling persona-conditioned empathy requires targeting structure beyond individual mechanism directions.

articles.titleCn: 共情是可引导的但多维度：大型语言模型中的机制几何与角色效应
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导已被用于控制诚实、拒绝和谄媚等特质，然而支持性共情则被多维评估，这些维度不一定对应于独立可控的激活方向。利用将支持性共情分解为情绪反应、解释和探索的EPITOME框架，我们研究了三种指令微调的大型语言模型，并探究从这些标签中推导出的候选方向是否产生可区分的干预效果，还是共享结构，以及角色提示如何与这些方向相互作用。我们发现，对比激活添加产生了一种稳定的中间层干预，始终如一地使EPITOME代理分数在模型间发生偏移，将共情分析从响应级评分扩展到更高层级。然而，恢复的方向只有部分可分离：引导一个方向会导致非目标偏移，手工制作的提示会改变共情特征，而不是隔离单一维度。角色提示显著改变了EPITOME分数，但配对激活偏移分解显示，恢复的子空间仅捕获了大约3%的角色诱导的15层平方激活偏移幅度。根据这种基于EPITOME的定义，表达的共情是可引导的但多轴的，控制角色条件下的共情需要针对个体机制方向之外的结构。

articles.title: Human-Grounded Calibration for Long-Text Image-Text Congruence in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Long-text image--text congruence scoring is increasingly important for vision-language systems that must evaluate whether detailed textual descriptions match visual content. However, raw similarity scores from dual-encoder models are difficult to interpret as calibrated congruence measures, especially under the modality gap between image and text embeddings. This paper proposes Congruency Score (CS), a lightweight calibration layer that maps image--text similarity evidence into a bounded score. Using DOCCI and Urban1k, we evaluate four frozen vision-language backbones and show that observed reductions in post-projection centroid distance do not uniformly improve image--text retrieval performance. Human-grounded evaluations on DOCCI further reveal a trade-off: direct post-hoc calibration preserves high association with human judgments, whereas selected projection-based configurations can reduce threshold-relevant slope and intercept distortions at the cost of retrieval performance and association strength. These results establish long-text image--text congruence scoring as a calibrated score-estimation problem, where retrieval performance, human association, and threshold calibration must be evaluated as distinct objectives. CS provides a lightweight way to expose and operationalize this separation.
articles.titleCn: 基于人类标注的长文本图像-文本一致性校准方法
articles.abstractCn: 长文本图像-文本一致性评分对于必须评估详细文本描述是否与视觉内容相符的视觉语言系统日益重要。然而，双编码器模型的原始相似度分数难以作为校准一致性度量进行解释，尤其是在图像和文本嵌入之间的模态差距下。本文提出一致性评分（CS），这是一种轻量级的校准层，将图像-文本相似度证据映射到有界分数。使用DOCCI和Urban1k，我们评估了四个冻结的视觉语言主干网络，并表明观察到的投影后质心距离的减少并不均匀地提高图像-文本检索性能。在DOCCI上的人体基准评估进一步揭示了一种权衡：直接的后期校准保留了与人类判断的高关联度，而选择的基于投影的配置则以牺牲检索性能和关联强度为代价，减少了与阈值相关的斜率和截距失真。这些结果将长文本图像-文本一致性评分确立为一个校准分数估计问题，其中检索性能、人体关联和阈值校准必须作为不同的目标进行评估。CS提供了一种轻量级的方法来揭示和实现这种分离。

articles.title: IROH: Insightful Ranking Of Humor using Multi-Stage Hybrid Retrieval with Rationale-Distilled LLM Judges for JOKER 2026 Track Task 1 English
articles.abstract: Our team, VANGUARD, presents IROH (Insightful Ranking of Humor), a three-stage retrieval system for JOKER Task 1 English at CLEF 2026, achieving first place on the leaderboard with 0.6347 MAP. Our pipeline combines hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a LoRA-adapted Large Language Model judge ensemble. We employ Gemma 4 to generate query-aware rationales under two prompt strategies, generic and typed, and produce up to four types of structured hard negatives for training data construction. Through an ablation across three cross-encoder architectures, four dense embedders, and eight judge configurations, our key findings are threefold: (1) the rationale-distilled judge is the primary driver of ranking quality, whereas appending rationales to the first-stage index contributes negligibly; (2) structured hard negatives degrade generalisation in nearly all configurations despite inflating local validation scores; and (3) across the components we ablate, the lighter, better-calibrated model is competitive with or stronger than its larger counterpart, with the generic-rationale Qwen2.5-7B judge (0.6055 MAP) outperforming every Gemma-4-31B configuration, and the advantage of generic over typed rationales is concentrated almost entirely in the smaller model.
articles.titleCn: IROH：基于多阶段混合检索与推理蒸馏LLM裁判的幽默洞察性排序，用于JOKER 2026赛道任务1英语
articles.abstractCn: 我们的团队VANGUARD在CLEF 2026的JOKER Task 1英语任务中提出了IROH（Insightful Ranking of Humor），一个三阶段检索系统，在排行榜上以0.6347的MAP成绩位居第一。我们的流程结合了混合稀疏-密集检索、交叉编码器重排序以及LoRA适配的大型语言模型判别器集成。我们采用Gemma 4，在通用和类型化两种提示策略下生成查询感知的推理，并为训练数据构造多达四种类型的结构化硬负样本。通过对三种交叉编码器架构、四种密集嵌入器以及八种判别器配置进行消融实验，我们的主要发现有三点：(1) 推理蒸馏的判别器是排序质量的主要驱动因素，而将推理附加到第一阶段索引的贡献微乎其微；(2) 结构化硬负样本尽管提高了局部验证分数，但在几乎所有配置中都降低了泛化能力；(3) 在我们消融的组件中，更轻量且校准更好的模型与更大模型相比具有竞争力或更优，通用推理的Qwen2.5-7B判别器（0.6055 MAP）优于所有Gemma-4-31B配置，通用推理相对于类型化推理的优势几乎完全集中在较小模型上。

articles.title: Through the Eyes of the Beholder: Biometric and Demographic Conditioning for Multimodal Sexism Detection
articles.abstract: Detecting sexism on the internet is a fundamentally subjective task; our team, VANGUARD, addresses this challenge in the EXIST 2026 Task 2 by proposing a human-centered multimodal framework that analyses and incorporates the psychological and demographic characteristics of human annotators into the detection pipeline. We fuse five input modalities through a cross-attention architecture with Feature-wise Linear Modulation conditioning. Meme text is extracted and visually described with Gemma 4, then augmented by automatic translation between English and Spanish with NLLB-200. Text and image representations are produced by LoRAadapted XLM-RoBERTa and CLIP encoders and fused with sensor features encoded by a pretrained autoencoder. To model annotator subjectivity, we frame Subtask 2.1 as a label distribution learning problem, optimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence loss over the full annotator label distribution. At inference time, predictions are produced by soft-voting between the deep multimodal network and a complementary SVM trained on stylometric and physiological features. Our best submission ranks 29th out of 114 on Subtask 2.2 (source intention) under soft evaluation, and the normalized ICM scores remain above the baseline on Subtasks 2.1 and 2.2, indicating that annotator-centered conditioning contributes a usable signal. We release our full pipeline and analysis to support reproducible human-centered modeling.
articles.titleCn: 通过观察者的视角：生物特征和人口统计条件下的多模态性别歧视检测
articles.abstractCn: 在互联网上检测性别歧视是一项根本上是主观的任务；我们的团队VANGUARD通过在EXIST 2026任务2中提出一个以人为本的多模态框架来应对这一挑战，该框架将人类标注者的心理和人口统计学特征分析并整合到检测流程中。我们通过具有特征线性调制调节的交叉注意力架构融合了五种输入模态。使用Gemma 4提取并视觉描述meme文本，然后通过NLLB-200在英语和西班牙语之间进行自动翻译进行增强。文本和图像表示由LoRA适配的XLM-RoBERTa和CLIP编码器生成，并与预训练自动编码器编码的传感器特征融合。为了模拟标注者主观性，我们将子任务2.1构建为标签分布学习问题，优化在全标注者标签分布上的Kullback-Leibler散度损失。在推理时，预测由深度多模态网络和基于文体学和生理学特征训练的互补SVM之间的软投票产生。我们的最佳提交在软评估下在子任务2.2（来源意图）中排名第29位（共114个），并且在子任务2.1和2.2中归一化ICM分数均高于基线，表明以标注者为中心的调节贡献了可用的信号。我们发布我们的完整流程和分析以支持可重复的人为本建模。

articles.title: Can We Trust the Judges? Validation of Factuality Evaluation Methods via Answer Perturbation
articles.abstract: Evaluating the factual correctness of large language models (LLMs) is vital for many applications. But are our evaluation tools themselves trustworthy? Despite the rise of factuality-based metrics, their sensitivity and reliability remain underexplored. This paper introduces a meta-evaluation framework that systematically tests these metrics using controlled corruptions of gold standard answers. Our method generates ranked outputs with known degrees of degradation to probe how metrics capture nuanced changes in truthfulness. Our experiments reveal that pipeline-based methods, such as the RAGAS's factual correctness metric, better track degradation than LLM-as-judge approaches. We also propose a new variant of the factual correctness metric that provides a competitive and cost-efficient.

articles.titleCn: 我们能信任法官吗？通过答案扰动验证事实性评估方法
articles.abstractCn: 评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的事实准确性对于许多应用至关重要。但我们的评估工具本身是否可信？尽管基于事实性的指标日益兴起，但其敏感性和可靠性仍待深入探索。本文介绍了一种元评估框架，该框架使用对标准答案进行受控破坏的方法系统地测试这些指标。我们的方法生成具有已知退化程度的排序输出，以探究指标如何捕捉真实性变化的细微之处。实验表明，基于流程的方法（如RAGAS的事实准确性指标）比LLM作为评判者方法更好地追踪退化。我们还提出了一种新的事实准确性指标变体，它具有竞争力和成本效益。

articles.title: Don't Count the Edits, Judge by the Outcome Alone: Reward-Based Evaluation for Grammatical Error Correction
articles.abstract: Grammatical error correction (GEC) evaluation has traditionally relied on reference or edit overlap, which can penalize valid rewrites that differ from gold corrections. Reference-free metrics reduce this dependence, but evaluating whether a fluent output is a valid correction of the source remains challenging. We propose SURE, a source-conditioned reward evaluator trained on within-source preferences spanning minimal-edit and rewrite-oriented corrections. SURE jointly learns an overall reward with criteria-level supervision for grammaticality, faithfulness, and fluency, together with span-level grounding for source-side error resolution. Experiments on SEEDA show that SURE performs competitively against strong baselines, with particular gains on rewrite-style corrections and more disentangled criteria-level diagnostics. Our code is available at https://github.com/hayeonggg/SURE.
articles.titleCn: 不要只数修改次数，仅凭结果评判：基于奖励的语法错误纠正评估
articles.abstractCn: 语法错误纠正（GEC）评估传统上依赖于参考或编辑重叠，这可能会惩罚与黄金纠正不同的有效重写。无参考指标减少了这种依赖，但评估流畅输出是否为源的有效纠正仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了SURE，一种基于源条件奖励评估器，在涵盖最小编辑和重写导向纠正的源内偏好上进行训练。SURE联合学习整体奖励，并提供语法性、忠实度和流畅性的标准级监督，以及源侧错误解决的跨度级基础。在SEEDA上的实验表明，SURE在强基线中表现出竞争力，特别是在重写风格纠正方面取得了显著提升，并且标准级诊断更加解耦。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hayeonggg/SURE获取。

articles.title: Option-Aware Retrieval and Task-Specific VLM Adaptation for Medical VQA
articles.abstract: We describe our submission to the MedReason 2026 challenge, covering multiple-choice (MCQ) and open-ended (OE) medical visual question answering (VQA) under fully offline, containerized inference. Our first finding is that MCQ retrieval must compare answer \emph{semantics} rather than answer labels: labels are independently assigned per question, so copying a retrieved neighbor's label transfers no useful information, whereas scoring each current option's text against correct-answer text from similar training cases raises retrieval-only accuracy from 20.0\% to 57.5\% on a 200-case retrieval-excluded development holdout. Our second finding attributes the submitted system's accuracy: holding the task-specific MCQ Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter fixed and varying the number \(k\) of in-prompt retrieved examples changes accuracy by at most one case --- 187/200 (93.5\%) at both \(k=0\) and the adapter's training-time \(k=1\), 188/200 (94.0\%) at the packaged runtime's default \(k=3\) --- and the submitted confidence-gated override adds no net accuracy on top of \(k=3\), selecting the VLM in 198/200 cases. With the final MCQ adapter fixed, retrieval changes accuracy by at most one case, and gating provides no net gain. On 20 OE cases, token-F1 and RaTEScore~\cite{zhao2024ratescore} decrease as \(k\) grows, but paired sign tests on token-F1 differences are nonsignificant (\(p \ge 0.29\)); a single-annotator comparison found 6/20 wrong-anchor errors for the final configuration and 14/20 for an earlier configuration that jointly differed in routing, adapter, and prompting. The system reaches 94.0\% MCQ accuracy on the development holdout and 93.20\% on the organizer's official pre-evaluation, versus 29.43\% for the off-the-shelf reference baseline, while both of the organizer's open-ended scores are lower than that baseline's (ground-truth agreement 1.245 versus 1.588, visual accuracy 1.995 versus 2.696, each out of 4).
articles.titleCn: 选项感知检索与任务特定视觉语言模型适配用于医学问答
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了提交给MedReason 2026挑战赛的工作，涵盖了在完全离线、容器化推理环境下进行的选择题（MCQ）和开放式（OE）医学视觉问答（VQA）。我们的第一个发现是，MCQ检索必须比较答案的\emph{语义}而非答案标签：标签是独立分配给每个问题的，因此复制检索到的邻近答案的标签不会传递任何有用信息，而将当前选项的文本与来自相似训练案例的正确答案文本进行评分，可以将仅检索的准确率从20.0%提高到57.5%（在200个案例的排除开发集上）。我们的第二个发现解释了提交系统的准确率：固定任务特定的MCQ低秩适配（LoRA）适配器，并改变提示中检索到的示例数量\(k\)，准确率最多变化一个案例——在\(k=0\)和适配器训练时的\(k=1\)时为187/200（93.5%），在打包运行时的默认\(k=3\)时为188/200（94.0%），而提交的置信度门控覆盖在\(k=3\)之上没有净准确率提升，在198/200案例中选择了VLM。在最终的MCQ适配器固定后，检索的准确率最多变化一个案例，门控也没有净收益。在20个OE案例上，token-F1和RaTEScore~\cite{zhao2024ratescore}随着\(k\)的增长而下降，但对token-F1差异的配对符号检验没有显著性（\(p \ge 0.29\)）；单标注员比较发现，最终配置有6/20错锚错误，而早期配置（在路由、适配器和提示上共同不同）有14/20错锚错误。该系统在开发集上达到94.0%的MCQ准确率，在组织者的官方预评估上达到93.20%，而现成的参考基线仅为29.43%，同时组织者的开放式得分均低于基线（真实值一致性1.245与1.588，视觉准确率1.995与2.696，均为满分4分）。

articles.title: To Each Language Its Tokenizer: Modular Tokenizers for Efficient Multilingual LLMs
articles.abstract: Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) traditionally rely on a single vocabulary shared by all supported languages, which can lead to uneven compression across them. Moreover, their large embedding and output matrices increase memory usage and slow inference, notably for small-scale models. It is also wasteful as models are often used for only a subset of languages. To address these issues, we introduce a modular framework for multilingual model training. First, we propose methods to learn large modular BPE and Unigram tokenizers that enable extraction of subtokenizers tailored to any language subset. These subtokenizers achieve compression on par with monolingual tokenizers and improve cross-lingual fairness. Second, we design a pretraining strategy that samples subtokenizers to form batches, restricting predictions to the relevant vocabulary subset and allowing efficient training despite a large vocabulary. This supports efficient inference with any combination of language-specific vocabularies. Therefore, it reduces memory usage and speeds up inference in models without sacrificing performance.
articles.titleCn: 每种语言都有其分词器：用于高效多语言大语言模型的模块化分词器
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型（LLMs）传统上依赖于所有支持语言共享的单一词汇表，这可能导致它们之间压缩效果不均。此外，它们的大型嵌入和输出矩阵增加了内存使用并减缓了推理速度，尤其对于小规模模型影响显著。同时，这也造成了浪费，因为模型通常只用于部分语言。为解决这些问题，我们引入了一个多语言模型训练的模块化框架。首先，我们提出了学习大型模块化BPE和Unigram分词器的方法，这些分词器能够提取针对任何语言子集的子分词器。这些子分词器实现了与单语分词器相当的水平压缩，并提高了跨语言公平性。其次，我们设计了一种预训练策略，通过抽取子分词器形成批次，将预测限制在相关的词汇子集，从而在词汇量大的情况下实现高效训练。这支持使用任何语言特定词汇组合进行高效推理。因此，它在不牺牲性能的前提下，减少了内存使用并加快了推理速度。

articles.title: Psychosis involves a deficit of information compression in connected speech
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with human-like performance on linguistic tasks have transformed the study of language in neurodiverse conditions. LLMs provide representations of linguistic input in the form of high-dimensional vectors (embeddings), and next-token predictions computed from these embeddings. Previous crosslinguistic evidence suggests a complexity reduction in the form of both lower intrinsic dimensionality (ID) of LLM representations and higher mean surprisal (prediction error) in psychosis. We hypothesized that these metrics reflect a general deficit of information compression in psychosis, linked to grammatical organization as what enables predictions in language.We operationalized surprisal difference as the difference between surprisal as estimated from word frequency and surprisal as based on a contextual LM, which is sensitive to grammatical organization over and above lexical concepts. Using a dataset of 144 Turkish speakers, including 106 patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders (SSD) - 56 with chronic schizophrenia (SZH), 33 with first-episode psychosis (FEP), and 17 with schizoaffective disorder (SZA) - and 38 healthy controls. We report: (1) Surprisal difference is attenuated in all clinical groups relative to controls, independently of word count; (2) Compressibility (intrinsic dimension) is reduced in SZH and FEP; (3) Syntactic complexity and compressibility both predict surprisal difference. These results, further refining an alteration in the geometry of the semantic space in psychosis as previously attested, suggest a broader deficit in information compression in this disorder, with a mechanistic underpinning in the operations of grammar.
articles.titleCn: 精神分裂症涉及连贯言语中信息压缩的缺陷
articles.abstractCn: 在语言任务上表现出类人性能的大型语言模型（LLMs）已经改变了神经多样性条件下语言研究。LLMs以高维向量（嵌入）的形式提供语言输入的表征，并基于这些嵌入计算下一词的预测。先前跨语言证据表明，精神分裂症中存在复杂性的降低，表现为LLM表征的内在维度（ID）降低和精神分裂症中更高的平均意外性（预测误差）。我们假设这些指标反映了精神分裂症中信息压缩的一般缺陷，这种缺陷与语法组织相关，而语法组织是语言预测的基础。我们将意外性差异操作化为从词频估计的意外性与基于上下文LLM的意外性之间的差异，后者对语法组织敏感，而不仅仅是词汇概念。使用一个包含144名土耳其语使用者的数据集，其中包括106名患有精神分裂症谱系障碍（SSD）的患者——56名慢性精神分裂症患者（SZH）、33名首次发作精神疾病患者（FEP）和17名分裂情感障碍患者（SZA）——以及38名健康对照者。我们报告： (1) 与对照组相比，所有临床组的意外性差异均减弱，且与词数无关； (2) 慢性精神分裂症和首次发作精神疾病患者的可压缩性（内在维度）降低； (3) 句法复杂性和可压缩性均能预测意外性差异。这些结果进一步细化了先前证实的在精神分裂症中语义空间几何形状的改变，表明该障碍中存在更广泛的信息压缩缺陷，其机制基础在于语法的运作。

articles.title: Beyond Safe Answers: Segment-Aware Listwise Alignment for Reasoning Safety in Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) pose a dual-surface safety challenge: both intermediate reasoning traces and final answers can contain harmful content. Existing alignment methods often operate at the whole-response level, allowing unsafe reasoning to be masked by a safe-looking final answer. We propose Segment-aware Listwise Target DPO (SaLT-DPO), which addresses this gap through three mechanisms: (1) segment-aware listwise alignment that decomposes responses into reasoning and answer segments, independently scores each segment's safety, and aligns length-normalized segment rewards with soft target distributions over multiple candidates; (2) joint safety coherence regularization that applies a weakest-link principle to promote safety consistency across both segments; and (3) utility anchoring on benign prompts to mitigate over-refusal and reasoning degradation. Experiments on three LRMs show that SaLT-DPO consistently reduces unsafe rates for both reasoning and answer segments while mitigating degradation in benign compliance and preserving general reasoning performance. Ablation studies demonstrate the complementary contributions of its components.
articles.titleCn: 超越安全答案：针对大型推理模型的推理安全性的分段感知列表式对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）面临着双重表层的安全挑战：中间推理轨迹和最终答案都可能包含有害内容。现有的对齐方法通常在整体响应层面操作，允许不安全的推理被看似安全的最终答案所掩盖。我们提出了感知片段的列表式目标DPO（SaLT-DPO），通过三种机制解决这一差距：（1）感知片段的列表式对齐，将响应分解为推理和答案片段，独立评分每个片段的安全性，并将长度归一化的片段奖励与多个候选的软目标分布对齐；（2）联合安全连贯正则化，应用最弱链原则来促进两个片段之间的安全一致性；（3）在良性提示上进行效用锚定，以减轻过度拒绝和推理退化。在三个LRMs上的实验表明，SaLT-DPO始终减少推理和答案片段的不安全率，同时减轻良性合规性的退化，并保持通用推理性能。消融研究展示了其各组成部分的互补贡献。

articles.title: Authorship attribution and aesthetic evaluation of AI poetry: a case study with Haiku
articles.abstract: This paper investigates the generation and human evaluation of Japanese haiku by contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on authorship perception and aesthetic judgment within a constrained poetic form. Using a few-shot prompting strategy, Japanese haiku were generated across a heterogeneous set of large language models, including open- and closed-source systems, medium-scale and large-scale architectures, models with native or adapted Japanese support, and multilingual proprietary models. These AI-generated haiku were combined with human-written ones and presented in a questionnaire distributed to students at Japanese universities in Tokyo. The survey assessed whether respondents could distinguish between AI-generated and human-written haiku and which cues informed their judgments. Recognition accuracy varied across models. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, and StableLM-7B performed at approximately chance level (approx 0.50), whereas LLM-JP, Gemma-2B, and LLaMA-2 showed moderate detectability (approx 0.59-0.67). However, recognition was strongly item-dependent. Ratings of fluency, coherence, poeticness, and related aesthetic dimensions predicted perceived humanness but not correct classification, indicating an attribution bias linked to aesthetic evaluation and revealing a dissociation between aesthetic evaluation and true authorship detection. The extended analysis additionally examines generation-constraint adherence, participant-level characteristics, and exploratory LLM-based evaluations of haiku authorship. Overall, the findings suggest that as LLMs improve, surface-level creative plausibility may reduce reliable human discrimination within constrained poetic settings.

articles.titleCn: 人工智能诗歌的作者归属与美学评价：以俳句为例的个案研究
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了当代大型语言模型（LLM）生成和人类评价日语俳句的过程，重点关注在受限的诗歌形式中作者身份感知和审美判断。采用少量提示策略，在一系列异构的大型语言模型中生成日语俳句，包括开源和闭源系统、中规模和大规模架构、原生或适配日语支持以及多语言专有模型。这些AI生成的俳句与人类创作的俳句结合，通过问卷呈现给东京日本大学的在校生。调查评估了受访者能否区分AI生成和人类创作的俳句，以及哪些线索影响了他们的判断。识别准确率因模型而异。GPT-5、Gemini 2.5和StableLM-7B的表现接近随机水平（约0.50），而LLM-JP、Gemma-2B和LLaMA-2显示出中等可检测性（约0.59-0.67）。然而，识别结果强烈依赖于具体项目。流畅性、连贯性、诗意性及相关审美维度的评分能预测感知的人性化程度，但不能正确分类，表明与审美评价相关的归因偏差，并揭示了审美评价与真实作者身份检测之间的分离。扩展分析还考察了生成约束遵守情况、参与者特征以及基于LLM的俳句作者身份探索性评估。总体而言，研究结果表明，随着LLM的改进，表层创造性合理性可能会降低人类在受限诗歌环境中的可靠区分能力。

articles.title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding? The Role of Numerical Precision in Orthrus
articles.abstract: Orthrus is a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion architecture that accelerates autoregressive language-model inference by generating multiple tokens in parallel while using a frozen autoregressive backbone. Its central claim is that an intra-model consensus mechanism enables lossless speculative decoding, producing the same output sequence as the autoregressive model. We independently reproduce Orthrus and examine this claim under different numerical precisions. Under BF16 inference, exact trajectory matching occurs in only 45% of cases for the authors' checkpoint and 43% for our independently trained model across 1,190 prompts from 12 domains. The probability of exact matching is also strongly associated with the response-conditional perplexity of the reference model. Despite this trajectory divergence, Orthrus does not show systematic degradation on downstream lm-eval-harness benchmarks. In contrast, repeating the trajectory evaluation with FP32 yields exact trajectory matching on all evaluated prompts. These results show that the practical losslessness of Orthrus depends on numerical precision and that exact trajectory equivalence should be evaluated separately from downstream task performance.
articles.titleCn: 无损推测解码的无损程度如何？数值精度在Orthus中的作用
articles.abstractCn: Orthus是一种混合自回归-扩散架构，通过使用冻结的自回归主干并行生成多个标记来加速自回归语言模型的推理。其核心主张是，模型内共识机制能够实现无损推测解码，产生与自回归模型相同的输出序列。我们独立地复现了Orthus，并在不同的数值精度下检验了这一主张。在BF16推理下，对于作者提供的检查点和我们独立训练的模型，在来自12个领域的1,190个提示中，精确轨迹匹配仅发生在45%的情况下，而我们独立训练的模型为43%。精确匹配的概率也与参考模型的响应条件困惑度密切相关。尽管存在轨迹分歧，Orthus在下游lm-eval-harness基准测试上并未显示出系统性的性能下降。相比之下，使用FP32重复轨迹评估时，在所有评估的提示上均实现了精确轨迹匹配。这些结果表明，Orthus的实际无损性取决于数值精度，且精确轨迹等价性应与下游任务性能分开评估。

articles.title: Temperature Fragility and the Conditional Benefits of Truncation Sampling
articles.abstract: Large language models generate text by sampling each token from a predicted distribution, and a temperature parameter sets how far the draw strays from the most probable tokens. Truncation samplers such as top-p and min-p discard the least probable tokens before the draw, so that sampling at high temperature stays coherent. Their reported accuracy gains come from temperatures of 1.5 to 3, while the defaults of deployed systems cluster between 0.6 and 1.0. Whether they change accuracy at those defaults, and for which models, has not been measured. We test thirteen open-weight models on GSM8K and MMLU-Pro at temperatures 0.7, 1.0, and 1.3 in one controlled pipeline, ten of them under eight decoding configurations. Six of the thirteen models lose 17 to 38 accuracy points on MMLU-Pro between 0.7 and 1.3, and the other seven lose at most 10. The lost accuracy comes from generations that run to the token limit or never state an answer. These results suggest that truncation samplers improve accuracy primarily when higher temperatures substantially degrade model performance. Where accuracy remains stable across temperatures, none of the tested truncation samplers improves on plain temperature sampling.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/larosafrancesco289/decoding-robustness
articles.titleCn: 温度脆弱性与截断采样的条件性收益
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通过从预测分布中采样每个标记来生成文本，而温度参数则设定采样偏离最可能标记的程度。截断采样器（如top-p和min-p）在采样前丢弃最不可能的标记，以便在高温下保持采样的一致性。它们报告的准确率提升来自于1.5到3的温度，而已部署系统的默认值则集中在0.6到1.0之间。这些默认设置下它们是否改变准确率，以及影响哪些模型，尚未得到测量。我们在GSM8K和MMLU-Pro上以0.7、1.0和1.3的温度，在一个受控的流程中测试了十三种开放权重模型，其中十种在八种解码配置下进行测试。十三种模型中有六种在MMLU-Pro上从0.7到1.3之间损失了17到38个准确率点，其余七种最多损失了10个。这些损失来自于达到标记限制或从未给出答案的生成结果。这些结果表明，截断采样器主要在高温显著降低模型性能时提升准确率。当准确率随温度变化保持稳定时，所测试的截断采样器均未优于简单的温度采样。

articles.title: Turkish MMLU Pro: Traceable Option Augmentation and Its Validity Limits in Turkish Multiple-Choice Evaluation
articles.abstract: Adding answer options can lower multiple-choice scores without improving assessment validity. Turkish MMLU Pro examines this distinction using 12,000 Turkish-source questions across 58 sections. Each question retains its stem, five original options and source key, and receives five options copied from other questions in the same section. Sentence-embedding retrieval proposes candidates; a language model selects existing identifiers. Deterministic verification reconstructs all 60,000 additions. A 25-model calibration exposes scoring and generation-budget effects. Five evaluations produce source-key accuracies of 34.8%-81.4%. On 981 shared questions, one API-served model falls from 93.7% with five choices to 83.1% with ten; 102 of 115 lost correct responses select borrowed options. The decrease is 24.4 percentage points on heuristically flagged negative stems and 5.9 points elsewhere. A completed human-checked audit of 200 sampled questions, with undocumented reviewer tool use, yields 47 and 31 multiple-answer judgments across the two record sets, 25 of the latter unresolved. These records support concern about ambiguity, while their dependence and incomplete reviewer-method documentation limit validation. Because order and labels also change, the paired comparison measures augmentation as implemented. The contribution is a traceable construction and an analysis of its validity limits, not evidence that lower ten-choice scores measure knowledge better.
articles.comment: Preprint of a manuscript submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
articles.titleCn: 土耳其MMLU Pro：可追溯选项增强及其在土耳其多项选择评估中的有效性限制
articles.abstractCn: 增加答案选项可能会降低选择题分数，而不会提高评估的有效性。土耳其MMLU Pro使用12,000个土耳其来源的问题，跨越58个部分，来检验这一区别。每个问题保留其题干、五个原始选项和来源键，并从同一部分的其它问题中复制五个选项。句子嵌入检索提出候选答案；语言模型选择现有标识符。确定性验证重建了所有60,000个新增内容。25个模型的校准暴露了评分和生成预算的影响。五次评估产生了34.8%-81.4%的来源键准确率。在981个共享问题中，一个由API提供服务的模型从五个选项的93.7%下降到十个选项的83.1%；115个问题中有102个丢失了正确答案，选择了借用选项。在启发式标记的负面题干上，分数下降了24.4个百分点，其它地方下降了5.9个百分点。对200个样本问题完成的、带有未记录的评审工具使用的、人工审核的审计，在两个记录集中产生了47和31个多答案判断，其中25个未解决。这些记录支持了对模糊性的担忧，但它们的依赖性和不完整的评审方法记录限制了验证。由于顺序和标签也会改变，配对比较测量了实际实施的增强效果。这项贡献是一个可追溯的构建及其有效性限制的分析，而不是证明十选答案分数更低能更好地衡量知识。

articles.title: MarKey: Marginal Utility Guided Greedy Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
articles.abstract: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) because densely encoding long frame sequences is computationally expensive, while uniform sampling under a limited visual budget can miss sparse yet decisive evidence. Recent training-free keyframe selection methods have enabled more efficient inference and yielded promising performance gains. However, many existing methods score frames largely in isolation without explicitly considering how each candidate complements the currently selected subset, potentially resulting in redundant selections and incomplete evidence coverage. To address this limitation, we propose MarKey, a training-free framework that formulates keyframe selection as subset-aware greedy optimization. At each iteration, MarKey scores each candidate using a tractable surrogate that jointly accounts for query relevance, marginal coverage gain, and context-dependent redundancy, and selects the frame with the highest utility. To make this iterative subset-aware evaluation efficient, MarKey uses a compact set of representative anchors to approximate full-video coverage and a bounded window of previously selected frames to limit context-dependent comparisons. Experiments on six benchmarks spanning holistic video understanding, human-centric video understanding, and open-ended video understanding demonstrate that MarKey consistently outperforms existing methods. Further analyses show robust gains across different MLLM backbones, model scales, and frame budgets.
articles.titleCn: MarKey：基于边际效用引导的贪婪关键帧选择方法用于长视频理解
articles.abstractCn: 长视频理解对于多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）来说仍然是一项挑战，因为密集编码长帧序列计算成本高昂，而在有限的视觉预算下进行均匀采样可能会遗漏稀疏但决定性的证据。最近的无训练关键帧选择方法实现了更高效的推理，并带来了显著的性能提升。然而，许多现有方法在评分帧时主要独立进行，而没有明确考虑每个候选帧如何补充当前已选子集，这可能导致冗余选择和证据覆盖不完整。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了MarKey，这是一个无训练框架，将关键帧选择表述为子集感知的贪婪优化。在每次迭代中，MarKey使用一个易于处理的替代方案对每个候选帧进行评分，该方案联合考虑了查询相关性、边际覆盖增益和上下文依赖冗余，并选择效用最高的帧。为了使这种迭代子集感知评估高效，MarKey使用一组紧凑的代表锚点来近似全视频覆盖，并使用一个有限窗口的先前选择的帧来限制上下文依赖比较。在涵盖整体视频理解、以人为本的视频理解和开放式视频理解的六个基准测试上的实验表明，MarKey始终优于现有方法。进一步分析显示，在不同MLLM骨干网络、模型规模和帧预算下均实现了稳健的性能提升。

articles.title: SlopShape: Identifying AI-Generated Commercial Web Content
articles.abstract: Word-level detectors identify unedited AI-generated text almost perfectly, but the literature documents their brittleness under rewording, and a word-level score neither characterizes a text nor identifies which AI model wrote it. We ask whether AI-generated text can be identified one level deeper, from structural signatures: how information is presented, in what order, with what evidence, and in what voice. We replicate StoryScope (Russell et al., 2026), which showed such patterns for AI-generated fiction, on commercial content: 2,250 pre-ChatGPT human blog posts from 268 company domains against 11,250 AI mirrors from five frontier models. A 214-feature instrument, applied by an LLM and validated in a human gold-annotation session (human-human kappa 0.928, human-model 0.946), detects AI posts from its 187 structural features alone at 98.0 macro-F1 on held-out companies, unchanged (98.1) when every AI post is reworded by its own model. The signal characterizes and attributes: AI posts share a tidy, self-announcing shape, 79.3% are attributed to the correct source against a 16.7% chance rate, and human posts occupy rare structural configurations. All effects replicate StoryScope's, consistent in direction and larger in magnitude. We release pipeline, instrument, prompts, code, and aggregate artifacts.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Verification artifacts and code: https://github.com/pulse-energy-eu/slopshape
articles.titleCn: SlopShape：识别AI生成的商业网络内容
articles.abstractCn: 词级检测器几乎完美地识别未经编辑的AI生成文本，但文献记录了它们在改写时的脆弱性，且词级评分既不能表征文本也不能识别其来源的AI模型。我们探究是否可以从更深层次的结构特征中识别AI生成文本：信息是如何呈现的、顺序如何、依据何种证据、以及采用何种语气。我们复制了StoryScope（Russell等人，2026年），该研究展示了AI生成小说的结构模式，并将其应用于商业内容：268个公司域的2250篇ChatGPT之前的博客文章与来自五个前沿模型的11250篇AI镜像文本进行对比。一个包含214个特征的检测工具，由大型语言模型应用并在人类黄金标注会话中验证（人类-人类kappa系数0.928，人类-模型0.946），仅通过其187个结构特征就能在保留公司数据上以98.0宏观F1分数检测AI文章，且在所有AI文章均由其自身模型改写时保持不变（98.1）。该信号能够表征并归属：AI文章共享整洁的自我宣告结构，79.3%被正确归属来源，概率仅为16.7%，而人类文章占据罕见结构配置。所有效应均复制了StoryScope的结果，方向一致且幅度更大。我们发布了流程、工具、提示、代码和汇总数据。

articles.title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
articles.abstract: Digital agents must often adapt to new environments whose interfaces, tools, and failure modes are not fully captured by pretrained models. We introduce \textbf{RSIAgent}, a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement through autonomous memory construction. RSIAgent coordinates curriculum, actor, and verifier agents to continually explore the environment, validate outcomes, and retain environment-specific knowledge, including reusable causal relationships between actions, conditions, and consequences. It further adopts a \textbf{broad-then-deep} exploration strategy, combining parallel broad recursive self-exploration for discovering diverse environment structures with focused deep self-exploration for uncovering hard cases, hidden constraints, boundary conditions, and previously unknown causal dependencies. The resulting memory is frozen and can be directly reused for downstream tasks without updating model parameters. Experiments on OSWorld-v2 and Agent's Last Exam show that RSIAgent substantially improves strong open-source models, enabling Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 to outperform frontier closed-source models including GPT-6.
articles.titleCn: RSIAgent：新环境中的递归自我改进自主探索
articles.abstractCn: 数字代理必须经常适应新环境，而这些环境的界面、工具和失效模式往往无法被预训练模型完全捕捉。我们介绍了 \textbf{RSIAgent}，这是一个无需训练的多智能体框架，通过自主记忆构建实现递归自我改进。RSIAgent 协调课程智能体、行动智能体和验证智能体，以持续探索环境、验证结果并保留特定于环境的知识，包括可重用的行动、条件和后果之间的因果关系。它进一步采用 \textbf{广度优先再深度优先} 的探索策略，结合并行广度递归自我探索以发现多样的环境结构，以及聚焦深度自我探索以揭示难解案例、隐藏约束、边界条件和先前未知的因果依赖关系。生成的记忆被冻结，可直接用于下游任务而无需更新模型参数。在 OSWorld-v2 和 Agent's Last Exam 上的实验表明，RSIAgent 大幅提升了开源强模型，使 Kimi-K3 和 GLM-5.3 超越了包括 GPT-6 在内的前沿闭源模型。

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting
articles.abstract: We study the adaptation of pretrained language models to univariate time-series forecasting through a parameter-efficient transfer learning framework, with the goal of understanding which design choices drive effective cross-modal transfer. While language models operate on discrete textual tokens, time series consist of continuous numerical observations with temporal dependencies. To bridge this modality gap, we project fixed-length time-series patches directly into the embedding space of a pretrained GPT-2 backbone, bypassing textual tokenization and treating the Transformer as a generic sequence encoder. Through controlled ablation studies on seven benchmark datasets spanning energy, weather, traffic, and finance, we analyze the effects of (i)~representation strategy (continuous embeddings versus textual serialisation), (ii)~adaptation regime (frozen backbone versus partial or full fine-tuning), (iii)~architectural components such as adapters, pooling strategies, and prediction heads, and (iv)~input context length. Continuous patch-based embeddings consistently outperform textual prompting and randomly initialised backbones. The adapted pipeline attains MASE within the range of specialised forecasting architectures while updating less than 1\% of total model parameters. Results further indicate that freezing the pretrained backbone and training lightweight projection and adapter modules provides a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off with stable behaviour across varying context lengths.
articles.titleCn: 预训练语言模型在时间序列预测中的参数高效适配
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过参数高效的迁移学习框架研究预训练语言模型在单变量时间序列预测中的适应性，旨在理解哪些设计选择能够驱动有效的跨模态迁移。语言模型处理离散文本标记，而时间序列则由具有时间依赖性的连续数值观测组成。为了弥合这种模态差距，我们将固定长度的时间序列片段直接投影到预训练GPT-2主干的嵌入空间中，绕过文本标记化，并将Transformer视为通用序列编码器。通过对涵盖能源、天气、交通和金融的七个基准数据集进行受控消融研究，我们分析了以下因素的影响：(i)表示策略（连续嵌入与文本序列化）、(ii)适应策略（冻结主干与部分或完全微调）、(iii)适配器、池化策略和预测头等架构组件，以及(iv)输入上下文长度。连续片段嵌入始终优于文本提示和随机初始化的主干。适应后的流程在更新不到1%模型参数的情况下，达到了与专用预测架构相当的平均绝对百分比误差（MASE）。结果进一步表明，冻结预训练主干并训练轻量级投影和适配器模块，能够在不同上下文长度下提供有利的精度-效率权衡，并保持稳定表现。

articles.title: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Efficient Latent-Space Inference in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) primarily perform inference at the token level, resulting in substantial memory overhead and compromised computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Extraction and Inference (DSEI) framework, which achieves segment-level inference within the latent space through a two-stage training strategy. First, we construct a Dynamic Semantic Autoencoder (DSAE) via self-supervised learning. DSAE dynamically extracts segment-level semantics and compresses them into compact latent representations via adaptive semantic weighting and gated fusion. Subsequently, we integrate the DSAE into the LLM architecture and train the model to infer over dense latent space. DSEI substantially reduces both input and generation sequences and significantly enhances inference efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on the Wanjuan dataset demonstrate that DSEI reduces perplexity by 48% compared to static sentence-level latent inference baseline. Furthermore, compared to standard LLMs using token-level inference, DSEI accelerates inference speed by 2.5$\times$ and reduces memory overhead by 90%.
articles.titleCn: 动态语义压缩：用于大型语言模型的高效潜在空间推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）主要在词元级别进行推理，导致显著的内存开销和计算效率下降。在本文中，我们提出了一种动态语义提取与推理（DSEI）框架，通过两阶段训练策略在潜在空间中实现片段级别的推理。首先，我们通过自监督学习构建动态语义自动编码器（DSAE）。DSAE通过自适应语义加权与门控融合，动态提取片段级别的语义并将其压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。随后，我们将DSAE集成到LLM架构中，并训练模型在密集潜在空间上进行推理。DSEI显著减少了输入和生成序列的长度，并显著提高了推理效率。在万卷数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，与静态句子级别潜在推理基线相比，DSEI将困惑度降低了48%。此外，与使用词元级别推理的标准LLMs相比，DSEI将推理速度提高了2.5倍，并将内存开销降低了90%。

articles.title: Clean Scores, Buried Evidence, and Confident Wrong: A Receipt-Based Audit of Frontier Agentic QA
articles.abstract: Frontier models score well on shallow document/chart reading tasks. In a controlled data-room audit, moving evidence into buried conditions reduced accuracy, increased forced declarations, increased tool calls, and increased cost per correct answer. Confidence and benchmark calibration did not fully capture wrong answers; a documented production incident shows fabricated structural claims can be mixed with accurate numeric tables. Agentic evaluations need claim-level receipts (statement-level provenance, not answer-level scores), condition-aware scoring, and human-adversarial verification - an auditing discipline, not a leaderboard. The setting we measure is financial due diligence; the setting we are building toward next is defense staff work, where the same buried-evidence shape appears. In both, the model is not a party to the consequences; the person who signs is. In plain terms: in the documented cases we examine, agents can pair accurate numbers with confident fabricated explanations, and the burden of proof must therefore move from the model to the evidence trail.

articles.titleCn: 清洁分数、隐藏证据和自信错误：一项基于收据的前沿代理问答审计
articles.abstractCn: 前沿模型在浅层文档/图表阅读任务上表现良好。在受控的数据室审计中，将证据移入隐藏条件会降低准确率，增加强制声明，增加工具调用次数，并提高每个正确答案的成本。置信度与基准校准未能完全捕捉错误答案；一份记录在案的生产事故表明，虚构的结构性声明可以与准确的数字表格混合出现。代理式评估需要声明级别的收据（陈述级别的溯源，而非答案级别的评分）、条件感知评分和人类对抗性验证——这是一种审计纪律，而非排行榜。我们测量的环境是财务尽职调查；我们接下来要构建的环境是国防人员工作，其中同样会出现隐藏证据的模式。在这两种情况下，模型都不是后果的当事人；签字的人才是。简而言之：在我们审查的案例中，代理可以将准确的数字与自信的虚构解释相匹配，因此证明责任必须从模型转移到证据链。

articles.title: Reducing the Output-Mode Gap in Speech Language Models via Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Autoregressive generation of interleaved text and acoustic tokens is a common approach to spoken-response generation in speech large language models. Although this design enables streaming generation with explicit textual guidance, generated acoustic tokens become part of the context for subsequent text predictions. Given identical speech inputs, we observe markedly lower answer accuracy for the internal text generated in speech-to-text-and-speech (S2TS) mode than for speech-to-text (S2T) responses. We term this discrepancy the \emph{output-mode gap} (OMG). To reduce OMG, we propose \emph{Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation} (JO-OPD), which distills the model's stronger S2T policy into joint generation using student-generated S2TS trajectories. At each text position, the S2T teacher provides soft targets from a text-only projection of the student's preceding outputs, while the student predicts from the corresponding full interleaved history. A preservation objective further regularizes native non-text predictions. Experiments on Step-Audio-2-mini and Baichuan-Audio-Instruct reveal OMG across two interleaved generation architectures. On Step-Audio-2-mini, JO-OPD reduces OMG from 42.87 to 16.26 percentage points on Spoken-MQA and from 29.72 to 13.04 points on speech-rendered GSM8K, with little change in S2T accuracy and substantially larger reductions than matched SFT baselines. ASR-based evaluation further shows a 7.49-point improvement in spoken-answer accuracy on Spoken-MQA.
articles.titleCn: 通过联合输出策略蒸馏减少语音语言模型的输出模式差距
articles.abstractCn: 在语音大型语言模型中，交错文本和声学标记的自回归生成是常见的语音响应生成方法。尽管这种设计能够实现带明确文本指导的流式生成，但生成的声学标记会成为后续文本预测的上下文。对于相同的语音输入，我们发现语音转文本再转语音（S2TS）模式下生成的内部文本回答准确率明显低于语音转文本（S2T）响应。我们将这种差异称为\emph{输出模式差距}（OMG）。为减少OMG，我们提出了\emph{联合输出在线策略蒸馏}（JO-OPD），该技术将模型更强的S2T策略蒸馏到联合生成中，使用学生生成的S2TS轨迹。在每个文本位置，S2T教师从学生先前输出的纯文本投影中提供软目标，而学生则根据相应的完整交错历史进行预测。保留目标进一步正则化原始非文本预测。在Step-Audio-2-mini和Baichuan-Audio-Instruct上的实验揭示了两种交错生成架构中的OMG。在Step-Audio-2-mini上，JO-OPD将Spoken-MQA的OMG从42.87个百分点降至16.26，将语音渲染的GSM8K的OMG从29.72降至13.04，S2T准确率几乎未变，且大幅优于匹配SFT基线。基于ASR的评估进一步显示，Spoken-MQA的语音回答准确率提高了7.49个百分点。

articles.title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents allocate test-time compute adaptively as they revise solutions, use tools, explore alternatives, and decide when to stop. This test-time strategy makes it difficult to measure how agent performance scales. We study open-ended tasks that provide continuous scores for intermediate submissions, making progress observable throughout long trajectories. We propose Elo-per-token analysis, which tracks the best solution found at each token budget and uses a Bradley-Terry model to aggregate within-task orderings into Elo ratings across tasks with different score scales. We apply it to four general-purpose agents on four open-ended benchmarks, with sessions of up to 100M tokens, and to three feedback-driven LLM optimization harnesses in controlled single-task interventions. Independent sampling provides a theoretically characterized reference, for which Elo grows linearly with log compute. Against this reference, agents can initially convert tokens into Elo faster than independent sampling, but their marginal gains diminish and eventually fall below the reference. In contrast, the strongest historical human contestants improve superlinearly over contest time on shared AtCoder Heuristic Contest tasks, providing evidence of continual learning and substantial headroom after agents slow down. We define the scaling inflection point as the per-session budget where marginal Elo gains match the independent-sampling reference. Using this point as the per-session budget, we split 100M tokens across parallel sessions on FrontierCS Polyomino Packing, gaining +264 Elo over one long session and +355 over ten short sessions.
articles.titleCn: 当代理减速时：通过每token的Elo分析理解LLM代理的测试时策略
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在修正解决方案、使用工具、探索替代方案以及决定何时停止时，会自适应地分配测试时的计算资源。这种测试时策略使得衡量代理性能的扩展性变得困难。我们研究开放式任务，这些任务为中间提交提供连续分数，使得在整个长时间轨迹中都能观察到进展。我们提出了基于Elo的每token分析，该方法跟踪每个token预算下找到的最佳解决方案，并使用Bradley-Terry模型将任务内的排序聚合为不同分数尺度任务间的Elo评分。我们将该方法应用于四个通用代理在四个开放式基准测试上的会话，会话长达1亿token，以及三个在受控单任务干预中由反馈驱动的LLM优化工具。独立采样提供了一个理论上表征的参考，对于该参考，Elo随计算量的对数线性增长。与此参考相比，代理最初能比独立采样更快地将token转换为Elo，但它们的边际收益逐渐减少，最终低于参考水平。相比之下，历史上最强的参赛者在与共享的AtCoder启发式竞赛任务中，随着时间的推移表现出超线性的改进，这为代理减速后持续学习和巨大潜力提供了证据。我们将扩展拐点定义为每会话预算，在该预算下边际Elo收益与独立采样参考相匹配。使用这一点作为每会话预算，我们在FrontierCS Polyomino Packing上并行会话中分配了1亿token，通过一个长时间会话获得了+264 Elo的提升，通过十个短时间会话获得了+355 Elo的提升。

articles.title: Reason What Matters: Retrieval-Grounded Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
articles.abstract: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) learns unified representations across modalities, enabling a single model to support diverse retrieval tasks. Recent methods use Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to better interpret multimodal inputs before generating embeddings for complex retrieval tasks and further optimize this reasoning process through GRPO with retrieval-based rewards. However, two limitations hinder corpus-scale deployment. GRPO assigns all CoT tokens the same advantage, without identifying input-supported claims or evidence that distinguishes the positive from negatives. Moreover, generating a complete CoT before each embedding introduces substantial latency, even when a partial trace already provides sufficient retrieval evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Reason What Matters (ReWAM), a retrieval-grounded reasoning framework that uses retrieval feedback to guide both credit assignment and reasoning computation. Specifically, we introduce Retrieval-aware Self-Distillation (RASD), which constructs privileged guidance from input-supported evidence that distinguishes the positive item from retrieved hard negatives. An on-policy self-teacher uses this guidance to refine trajectory-level feedback into token-specific supervision for retrieval-relevant reasoning. We further develop Retrieval-adaptive Inference (RAI), which uses a retrieval confidence head to estimate the remaining retrieval utility of a partial CoT. It stops unproductive traces early and accelerates useful continuations with speculative decoding. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and MRMR demonstrate that ReWAM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance while delivering up to 5x the inference throughput of competitive explicit-CoT UME methods. These results bridge the gap between retrieval quality and inference efficiency, making reasoning-enhanced UME practical for large-scale deployment.
articles.titleCn: 重要原因：用于通用多模态嵌入的检索式推理
articles.abstractCn: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）学习跨模态的统一表示，使单个模型能够支持多样化的检索任务。近期方法使用思维链（CoT）推理来更好地解释多模态输入，并在生成复杂检索任务的嵌入之前进一步优化这一推理过程，通过基于检索的奖励使用GRPO。然而，有两个限制阻碍了语料库规模的部署。GRPO将所有CoT标记赋予相同的优势，而没有识别出支持输入的论点或证据，这些论点或证据区分了正面和负面。此外，在每次嵌入之前生成完整的CoT会引入显著的延迟，即使部分轨迹已经提供了足够的检索证据。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了关注重要推理（ReWAM），这是一个基于检索的推理框架，使用检索反馈来指导信用分配和推理计算。具体来说，我们引入了检索感知自蒸馏（RASD），它从区分正面项目与检索到的硬负面的输入支持证据中构建特权指导。一个在线策略自教师使用这种指导将轨迹级反馈细化为检索相关推理的特定标记监督。我们进一步开发了检索自适应推理（RAI），它使用检索置信度头来估计部分CoT的剩余检索效用。它在早期停止无生产力的轨迹，并使用推测解码加速有用的延续。在MMEB-V2和MRMR上的大量实验表明，ReWAM实现了最先进的检索性能，同时提供了比竞争的显式CoT UME方法高高达5倍的推理吞吐量。这些结果弥合了检索质量与推理效率之间的差距，使推理增强的UME适用于大规模部署。

articles.title: Artificial entrepreneurial cognition: Locating and causally steering an opportunity recognition dial inside large language models (LLMs)
articles.abstract: Entrepreneurial cognition is a foundation of entrepreneurship research. Yet the growing involvement of large language models (LLMs) in entrepreneurial work extends the cognition question beyond human actors to systems whose internal representations remain largely unexplored. We introduce artificial entrepreneurial cognition, the functional organisation of entrepreneurship-relevant representations and computations inside artificial intelligence (AI) systems. We bring mechanistic interpretability into entrepreneurship research through representation engineering. Focusing on opportunity recognition (OR), we construct 636 matched OR-present and OR-absent scenario pairs and recover an OR direction in Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct. Rather than infer the construct from outputs, we intervene directly on this direction, steering the model up and down along what we call the opportunity recognition dial, and its opportunity judgments shift with it. To our knowledge, this is the first causal intervention on an internal representation of an entrepreneurship construct inside an LLM. Held-out tests, lexical and topical controls, behavioural ablation, and geometric comparisons show that the direction is recoverable, consequential, and distinct from the opportunity evaluation and exploitation directions, although steering it also shifts judgments about these neighbouring stages. Recovery, signed steering, and geometric separation hold across four additional LLMs spanning different scales and families. These results give the contested distinction between opportunity recognition and evaluation a concrete representational form inside AI systems. More broadly, they establish internal representations as a new object of entrepreneurship inquiry and show how entrepreneurship theory can guide their identification, causal manipulation, and interpretation.
